objects.description: [PoetRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0428) has the ability to copy files and download/upload files into C2 channels using FTP and HTTPS.(Citation: Talos PoetRAT April 2020)(Citation: Talos PoetRAT October 2020)
